label: Daratumumab
intro: Daratumumab is a monoclonal antibody. Its special-population evidence on the platform comes from the Luo 2021 population PK model. The platform checked that model against older studies (Simulation 3.2b-3.2c); the albumin effect did not transfer as expected.

model.title: Luo 2021 daratumumab population PK (J Clin Pharmacol 61:614), Table S1

scope.title: Platform scope of the Luo 2021 model
scope.extraction: Platform scope file written from locked results (not an extraction).

kidney.text: Renal function was tested and not retained in the population model.
kidney.value: Renal and hepatic function were tested and not retained; the population had eGFR down to about 20 mL/min/1.73 m2 and mostly normal liver function (Table 2).
kidney.population: 742 patients with multiple myeloma in PAVO Part 2, MMY1008, COLUMBA and PLEIADES (subcutaneous and intravenous)

liver.text: Hepatic function was tested and not retained (same statement).
liver.value: Renal and hepatic function were tested and not retained; the population had eGFR down to about 20 mL/min/1.73 m2 and mostly normal liver function (Table 2).
liver.population: 742 patients with multiple myeloma in PAVO Part 2, MMY1008, COLUMBA and PLEIADES (subcutaneous and intravenous)

age.text: Whether age was tested in the Luo 2021 model, and the label's geriatric statement, are not extracted on the platform.

body_size.text: Clearance scales with body weight as (weight / 78.6 kg) to this power.
body_size.population: 742 patients with multiple myeloma in PAVO Part 2, MMY1008, COLUMBA and PLEIADES (subcutaneous and intravenous)

body_size.text: Central volume scales with body weight to this power.
Weight range (kg) inside the model's data.

other_covariates.text: Albumin: clearance scales as (albumin / 37 g/L) to this power (lower albumin, higher clearance).
Platform finding on the albumin effect.
other_covariates.value: Albumin is a covariate on clearance; the model's studies span 19-53 g/L (model_extract population, Table 2 ranges). The albumin effect may not transfer to GEN501/SIRIUS (check v2).

other_covariates.text: IgG myeloma: shift on clearance (clearance = 1 + this value times non-IgG, i.e. 2.26-fold).

other_covariates.value: The sex factor on V1 is read from a garbled line; the reference sex is uncertain.

not_this: A research summary of sourced findings. Not dosing guidance.
